items.title: 33.8 Aaloodgi aur bachat ke qawaid-o-zawabit (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of rules and regulations on water pollution (PDF 259).

blocks.text: Hukoomat-e-Punjab ne apne daera-e-ikhtiyar mein pani ki aaloodgi se nimatne ke liye kai acts aur qawaneen banaye hain. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Punjab tamam mutalliqa fareeqon ke liye ba-qaida qawaid-o-zawabit jari karti hai. Table 33.3 pani ki aaloodgi par qaboo aur bachat ke ahem qawaid ka jaiza deta hai, jaisa kitab mein chhapa hai.

blocks.caption: Table 33.3 Ahem mahol ke qawaneen aur bachat ke iqdamat (jaisa kitab mein chhapa)
rows: Rs 5 million tak jurmana, saath rozana Rs 100,000 tak izafi jurmana
Aaloodgi daalne ya bahao rokne ki mumaniat
3 mahine tak qaid aur/ya Rs 500,000 jurmana
Punjab Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act, 2023
Pani ke istemal aur nikas ki fees muqarrar karta; sanati aur zarai aaloodgi rokne ke liye ikhraj ke permits ko qaboo karta
Punjab Water and Sanitation Authority Act, 2025
Bare shehron (Lahore, Multan waghera) mein mutahid wasail ke intizam aur zameeni pani ki bachat ke liye Authority qaim karta

blocks.title: Maujooda qanoon dekhein
blocks.text: Acts, sazaein aur Did You Know ka jurmana kitab ke mutabiq diye gaye hain aur maujooda qawaneen se jaanche nahi gaye. Qawaneen aur jurmane badalte hain; maujooda matan ke liye EPA Punjab aur sarkari gazette dekhein. Jaanch ke liye nishan zada.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke gari dhone ke liye pipe ka istemal, aur gharelu lawns ya baghon ki selabi aabpashi, par Pakistan Penal Code ke tehat Rs 10,000 jurmana hai.

blocks.prompt: Punjab ka kaun sa act aaloodgi daalne ya pani ka bahao rokne se mana karta hai, aur kitab kya saza batati hai?
blocks.explanation: Punjab Water Act, 2019; 3 mahine tak qaid aur/ya Rs 500,000 jurmana.

items: EPA Punjab pani ki aaloodgi par qawaid jari karti.
Acts: Environmental Protection Act 1997, Water Act 2019, Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act 2023, Water and Sanitation Authority Act 2025.
